extDescription.message: Export WhatsApp Web chats to TXT, JSON or CSV, entirely in your browser.

errNoWhatsApp.message: Open WhatsApp Web in this window to export a chat.

errNoChat.message: Open a chat in WhatsApp Web, then open this again.

errConnect.message: Can't reach WhatsApp Web. Reload its tab and try again.

incAiNote.message: Images and voice notes go to Google Gemini with your key.

incOlderNote.message: If this browser runs out of messages, the chat is scrolled and WhatsApp's “older messages” notice is tapped once.

incMediaNote.message: Downloads up to $1 items from the last $2 days, like tapping Download.

trustLocal.message: Runs in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.

trustNetwork.message: Runs in this browser. Options marked “Uses network” connect to the internet.

cancelling.message: Cancelling. Messages read so far are kept.

phMediaCache.message: Reading photos saved in this browser ($1 of $2)…

phOlder.message: Loading older messages from your phone…

doneReady_one.message: $1 message ready. Download it or copy it.

doneReady_other.message: $1 messages ready. Download them or copy them.

partialCancelled.message: Cancelled, so only the messages read before that were exported.

partialOlder.message: Partial: this browser only has messages back to $1. Turn on “Older messages from your phone” to go further.

partialGeneric.message: Partial: WhatsApp didn't load the whole range. Scroll up in the chat and try again.

usedClassic.message: Used the classic reader, because the fast one doesn't work with this WhatsApp version.

noMessages.message: No messages in that range. Pick other dates or a larger number.

errExtraction.message: Export failed: $1. Reload WhatsApp Web and try again.

errDatesOrder.message: The start date must be before the end date.

errCount.message: Enter how many messages to export.

optReaderFastHint.message: Reads the chat from WhatsApp Web's own data, without scrolling. Falls back to the classic reader when it can't run.

optReaderClassicHint.message: Scrolls through the chat on screen. Slower, and it leaves out reactions and poll votes.

optMediaHint.message: Older media has usually expired, and asking for it makes WhatsApp request it again from the sender's phone. That's why the limit is 30 days.

optGeminiIntro.message: Describes images and transcribes voice notes with your own Google AI Studio key. Only used for exports where you turn it on.

optKeyBad.message: Google rejected the key (status $1). Copy it again from Google AI Studio.

optTranscribe.message: Transcribe voice notes up to 5 minutes

optPromptHint.message: Leave empty to use the default, in your language.

optPromptPlaceholder.message: Describe the main objects and people in one short sentence…

optPrivacyText.message: Exports are built in this browser and saved where you choose. Nothing is uploaded, except what you turn on yourself: images and voice notes sent to Gemini, and recent media requested from WhatsApp.
